samples.question: The four rows are stitched into one navy tapestry. In the gold-tagged source row, cyan squares are ON and cream squares are OFF. For each of the seven positions, the transformed square is ON exactly when exactly one of the left, current, and right source squares is ON; the two ends wrap around and are neighbors. Which colored-tag row is exactly the transformed row? Answer red, green, or blue.
